label: Adaptive discovery repair on six unresolved Fourth Way targets: diagnoses, guided retries, controls
summary:
Failure diagnosis and guided retry (#1833; scripts/discover_blueprint.py repair/retry, docs/discover.md, 'Adaptive repair') on the six Fourth Way targets left unresolved by #1826 and the #1832 pilot (attempts e63628f1, e8bf6def, and b979db99 for the #1848 sense tags). All runs at cf7a567a5 (main after #1848), Duper only, pool all; solver inputs keyed by the corpus, library and Discover scripts, not by the repair tool. CONTROL A, the original search with unchanged inputs (run-discovery.sh, 8 candidates, 100k heartbeats): 6 of 6 unresolved, 293 s run. CONTROL B, the same search with a larger budget (24 candidates, 300k heartbeats): 1471 s run; 64498e7e closed from f8ba2429 and d0fc96b7, filtered as known (e8a3eb51); a9622441 closed only from 6c27657f and 15c570f5, filtered as domain_by_name, senses (BEING_1/BEING_3, MAXIMAL_IN_A_SELECTED_PERFECTION_GREATEST_1/2/6) and witness, i.e. noise; 4 unresolved. GUIDED: 19 exact solver runs, 150 s of Lean time in total, at most four per target, each chosen by the planner from the diagnosis and recorded in the trace with its reason. Results per target. 64498e7e: the premises of e8a3eb51 close it, filtered as known; the split through 634a80b8 (route 400ba1f0) stays unresolved, the Cartesian frame-bound carriers W, B, T, R are not identified (tagging them is the open obligation); one-point countermodel of the 8-candidate bundle not found. 4c79298d: the premises of 4d1efe91 close it (minimization drops ee4ab504: known modulo excluded middle, which Duper's classical logic supplies); the 8-candidate bundle is jointly satisfiable in a one-point model, has no one-point countermodel and stays unresolved at 400k heartbeats (not refuted). The plain search misses it because retrieval eligibility admits neither MoreInIsAsymmetric a4814f25 nor MoreSuchHasThePerfectionReading c11369aa (attempt b979db99), not because of binding: with the #1848 tags no same-named binder of the bundle is left separate (all binders tagged and joined, per the local trace.json). eaa4c679: the premises of d27dd642 (result c9bdd003) close it, known modulo excluded middle; the reuse of e39a4fce (GodNamesTheUniqueMaximeEns) does not. 101bdd62: 5a948c37 closes it, known (8542e377); the engine's senses filter on that pair (MAXIMAL_IN_A_SELECTED_PERFECTION_GREATEST_1/6) stays the open definition-link question of attempt b979db99. 6c27657f: the premises of 1dff22d0 and of c201b61a, no same-named binder left separate (all binders tagged and joined, per the local trace.json), do not close within 100k heartbeats: a proof-search gap, not a binding or retrieval gap. Both routes use NoInfiniteRegressOfCausesOfAPerfectionReading 5cda1946, whose content is a WellFounded relation, and the verified proofs use well-founded reasoning that Duper does not search over opaque WellFounded. a9622441: the cogito route bfaf6f92 stays blocked on identification: the untagged MotionMapsBatch1 binders Occurs and Bears (ThinkerLives) and nobile, bonum, verum (LivingMoreNobleThanMerelyExisting, NobilityGradeConvertible) stay separate from the same-named binders of CogitoSubject and of the target; the reuse of e4e6b0cd (GradesToMaximumAtBeing) leaves its InAct, MoreIn, esse separate although they carry the same whole-binder tags, because their types are not definitionally equal to the target's. No one-point countermodel was found for any engine bundle, so a budget failure is not excluded for them; no diagnosis (e) was supported, and the engine's bridges (CausesIn x1 x2 x3 implies InAct x1 x3; PriorSimply x1 x2 implies IsGod x1; InAct x1 x2 implies IsGod x1) remain OPEN candidate propositions, as in #1826, not adopted. No new relationship: every closed goal composes from a verified argument, so nothing is registered. RUNNER FINDINGS. (1) A binder can carry both a whole-binder and a partial-application tag (CausalMapsBatch1.CauseOfBeingHasWhatItGives.CausesIn: CAUSE_2 and CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3 on _ _ esse); senseOf in scripts/Discover.lean takes the first tag, so the identification depends on tag order. The repair passes tags in the engine's order (records by id) and flags such binders; a first run with sorted tags left e8a3eb51 unclosed for that reason alone and was discarded. (2) An early version counted the wait for the heavy-job lock against the Lean time limit; its three timed-out 4c79298d runs were discarded and the limit now bounds Lean only. Neither discarded run is a solver outcome. AFTER #1850 (retrieval by whole-binder sense tags; excluded middle granted in the known filter to a proof using Classical.choice; measured in the #1850 PR body at the same options as control A): the plain search now gives 64498e7e known (e8a3eb51), eaa4c679 known modulo excluded middle (d27dd642, flagged implicit_excluded_middle) and 101bdd62 known (8542e377) with the senses flag, the closures the guided retries found here, which corroborates the retrieval diagnosis (b) for them. 4c79298d is proved there from a different bundle, 18561596 MaximumHasNoDistinctEsseCause, fad8af3e SomeBeingMaximalInBeing and 86d02b69 GodCausesBeingOfAllOthers, but filtered domain_by_name because the Being/Respect carriers of TermSenseForks are untagged: new (c) evidence, an identification obligation, not a result. 6c27657f and a9622441 stay unresolved there as here. The repair's own known check now follows the engine's rule (excluded middle only for a classical proof); the three modulo-logic closures above used Classical.choice. A delivered repair mechanism establishes none of its targets.

CURRENT TOOLKIT FOLLOW-UP 2026-11-24 (frozen scripts/testdata/discovery-benchmark.json, SHA-256 ffbdb95ca2166b85440c6dfc382f79aa6ebfb0679ccfe91ca9c95b69c45fda56). The engine now accepts an exact --premise bundle and applies its existing proof, minimization, identification, rejection and certification path to it. Carrier attempt b979db99 records the four 4c79298d comparisons: all unresolved at the frozen --heartbeats 10000 budget, with exact name-only obligations 2 to 0. The ranked run already retrieved all three reference premises, so this case supplies no current retrieval-miss evidence. A separate exact 100000-budget comparison proves the same bundle before and after curation; the sole domain_by_name rejection disappears after the reviewed tags, and the emitted proof is certified. This is the previously reported #1850/#1860 relationship, not new philosophy. Follow-on argument 14cbab05/result d377c7c7 registers this conditional support option. At coordinator revision 5ddbb714ed928b37823c83e241a3351f16f15dc7, the build, focused binding, Comparator and NanoDa gates pass. Three Lean-checked omission models show that each listed hypothesis is needed within this fixed encoded bundle; the joint satisfiability witness has IsGod false, so it is not a God-existence or nonvacuity witness. Independent review on 2026-11-24 accepted the complete semantic/research outcome at reviewed revision b396ef0d004daf2bdc5a2f118b8bee3aea5c1506 against main 6ecc2d87c3576906cb32ea8dbbca22e7557cce6b, with no blocking semantic, mathematical, source-boundary or measurement findings; see b979db99 for the exact gate and model scope. See PR #1928 for the current delivered-head CI status.

HELD-OUT AND NEGATIVE CONTROLS. The assertion family was fixed before the runs, independently of the maximality tag choice. For SomeMeaningfulContent f7e3ad49, ranked baseline ad4ffa2e5 (20261124T094602Z-515Er1jP) retrieves only 42114721 of the two reference premises, missing AssertionMade b45ca9db; its two eligible candidates are 42114721 and the opposing NoMeaningfulContent aee6dbdf, and the goal stays unresolved in 99 s. Supplying b45ca9db plus 42114721 exactly at 4b04b0352 (20261124T100300Z-9vdjUcJ0, same 10000 budget, batch 1/jobs 1) proves the goal in 22 s with no name-only identification and is correctly filtered known by argument 8a3dcfc2. This is successful use of a supplied known bundle, not improved automatic recall or a novel derivation. Supplying b45ca9db alone (20261124T100335Z-3uc77hcz) remains unresolved in 23 s. Its generated OPEN proposal quantifies over every agent and every content (Asserts a c implies Meaningful c); existing 42114721 concerns only the selected claim, so the proposal is broader, is not established as necessary or weakest, and is not adopted. Omission of hMeaning from the existing meaningFromAssertion theorem separately yields a Lean-checked model with one Agent and one Content (Fin 1/Fin 1), the assertion present and meaning absent. This is formal non-entailment under that vocabulary, not a philosophical claim that actual assertion lacks meaning. The registered full theorem also closes in the existing prove-sweep portfolio by unfold+grind in 2 s; neither test imports a Solution theorem as a discovery premise.

SOLVER CONTROL. For 6c27657f, ranked baseline (20261124T094754Z-S02ZATkz) remains unresolved in 105 s and omits 5cda1946 (the well-founded causal-regress premise) from its cap-8 candidates. Its reference bundle from 1dff22d0, supplied exactly as c11369aa+d5a94eb1+f29a6b53+5cda1946+ee4ab504 (20261124T100412Z-TG6lNYDy, 4b04b0352, 10000 budget), remains unresolved in 28 s with no name-only identifications. The existing gradesHaveAMaximum proof uses well-founded induction. The exact-run failure therefore persists after retrieval and identification are supplied; it is not a countermodel or evidence of a missing philosophical premise. The next deterministic experiment is the existing Mathlib WellFounded.has_min theorem, specialized to distinct CausesIn causes and the set of bearers of the selected perfection; no new axiom is justified.

BOUNDARIES AND RETRIEVAL CONTROL. countermodel on existenceFromOccurrence with hRepresents omitted exits 2, code unavailable, for the function parameter represent : Episode → Being. On ReceivedEsseActualGiver.actualGiverImpliesB2 with hGiver omitted it likewise exits 2 for F : CausalityFrame W B T R. These are unsupported-vocabulary reports, not non-entailment or exhaustive absence of a model. The independent retrieval-correctness fixture is unchanged across the baseline and candidate binaries: the six synthetic cases give semantic recall at 5 of 6/6, precision at 5 of 6/12, and novelty correctness of 6/6; the historical cases recover 5/5 known-work references and give 4/4 correct novelty verdicts. No general retrieval-quality improvement is claimed. Agent token and effort costs were not measured. Raw reports, commands and revision/binary hashes are in the local discovery-evidence directory; this follow-up and b979db99 retain the measured interpretation, and docs/discover.md remains the current toolkit guide. No target premise is established by these tooling outcomes.
